conventions.open_right_endpoint: The integer-length minimum for (n,n+L) is H(n)+1.
conventions.rough_part: Primes p>=q belong to R_q; the complementary part has P^+<q.
conventions.tail_family: P^+(s)<=y, s>u, positive integer d, real y>=1 and u>=0; P^+(1)=1.
